## Findings
- claim-1: In \(\bar\Lambda=\Lambda/I_{r,n-r}\), the classes \(\bar s_\lambda\), \(\lambda\subseteq(n-r)^r\), are an integral Schur basis, with truncated Littlewood–Richardson multiplication. [doi:10.1112/jlms.12832, lines 213-218]
- claim-2: For \(i=s-t+1,\ j=r-t+1,\ a=\min(n-r-i,r-j),\ b=\min(i,j)\), the lower-adjoined family \(\{\bar s_\mu:i^j\subseteq\mu\subseteq(i^j,b^a)\}\) generates \(J_v\). [doi:10.1112/jlms.12832, lines 219-235]
- claim-3: For every valid \(\varphi=(n,r,i,j,a,b,N)\), every tall row \(\operatorname{Lin}_\varphi(\rho)\) is an integral combination of original wide rows, retaining all variables \(A_{\lambda,\theta}\).
- claim-4: The lower-adjoined residue classes form a homogeneous integral basis: \[ J_v/A_+J_v\cong \bigoplus_{\rho\subseteq b^a}\mathbb Z[\bar s_{(i^j,\rho)}]. \]
## Strategy
Using source-backed Schur basis and generation, \(G_L\) gives a graded surjection
\[
\bigoplus_{\rho\subseteq b^a}\mathbb Z e_\rho\twoheadrightarrow J_v/A_+J_v.
\]
The accepted task-292 full-coordinate integral tall-to-wide identity, together with the source syzygy-to-linear-system reduction [doi:10.1112/jlms.12832, lines 326-344], rules out every positive-degree kernel component. The degree-\(ij\) component is immediate, including \(a=0\). Thus
\[
J_v/A_+J_v\cong
\bigoplus_{\rho\subseteq b^a}\mathbb Z[\bar s_{(i^j,\rho)}].
\]
The requested lower-adjoined integral-basis target is established, conditional on accepted task 292. No \(G_L\)-to-\(G_R\) computation is used.

## Gaps
No flaw was identified by the critic; no repair is required. The tall-to-wide identity is accepted internal evidence from task 292, not an independently source-backed theorem.
